job.title: [Post] Hiring #Salesforce #Lead #Architect #C2C #SFCC Job Title: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC)…

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Architect & Team Lead | Java, Spring, API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, micro-services and OCC REST APIs, designing PIM/ERP/MDM integrations and leading technical teams. Proven record of architecting data pipelines, API migrations and production support while bridging business and IT with AI-assisted analysis and delivering high-performance solutions.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Architect & Team Lead
cover_en.hook: I am excited about the opportunity to lead your Salesforce Commerce Cloud initiatives, bringing a proven track record of architecting large-scale e-commerce platforms. Over the past 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell I have delivered robust SAP Commerce Cloud solutions that drive revenue and customer engagement.

bullets.label: **Technical Architecture**
bullets.text: Designed and delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation, architecting OCC REST APIs and data pipelines that align with enterprise commerce strategies.

bullets.label: **Integration Expertise**
bullets.text: Led PIM/ERP/MDM integrations using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, ensuring seamless product data flow across global channels.

bullets.label: **Team Leadership**
bullets.text: Provided technical guidance and code reviews for junior developers, driving agile delivery and maintaining high code quality.

bullets.label: **AI-Assisted Delivery**
bullets.text: Accelerated analysis, development and documentation with generative AI tools, reducing time-to-market for new features.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany with a valid work permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. Open to remote, hybrid or on-site work and eager to discuss how I can add value to your team.

tailoring.why_company: Vamsi Krishna’s vision to build a best-in-class Salesforce Commerce Cloud platform aligns perfectly with my passion for shaping high-performance e-commerce architectures. I am eager to apply my deep SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, API-first mindset and proven leadership to accelerate your digital commerce roadmap, drive cross-functional collaboration, and deliver measurable business outcomes for your clients across Texas and California.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to lead your SFCC team, leveraging my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud architecture and integration experience to drive innovative commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud architect with 5+ years of experience. I’m excited about the SFCC Architect & Team Lead role and would love to discuss how my background can help your team succeed.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Salesforce Commerce Cloud Architect & Team Lead
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Salesforce Commerce Cloud Architect & Team Lead position. With over five years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute to your team’s success.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for this role.
